STATE PUBLIC PROSECUTOR  HIGH COURT BUILDING  BENGALURU - 560 001.
2. SARASWATHI @ POOJA  W/O NAVEEN KUMAR  AGED ABOUT 35 YEARS  R/AT SANNENAHALLI  THIPPASANDRA HOBLI  MAGADI TALUK, RAMANAGARA - 562 131.
 ...RESPONDENTS (BY SMT. SOWMYA R., HCGP FOR R1)
 THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/
S.482 CR.P.C PRAYING TO QUASHING THE REGISTRATION OF CR.NO.318/2022 PENDING FOR THE INVESTIGATION ON THE FILE OF KUDUR POLICE STATION AND PRINCIPAL CIVIL JUDGE (JR.DN.) AND J.M.F.C.

, AT MAGADI AGAINST THE PETITIONERS FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S 323, 498A, 504,
506 OF IPC AND SECTION 3 AND 4 OF DOWRY PROHIBITION ACT, CONSEQUENTLY QUASH THE ENTIRE PROCEEDINGS PENDING THEREON.

THESE PETITIONS, COMING ON FOR REPORTING SETTELEMENT, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER Learned High Court Government Pleader on verification of the records would submit that the police after investigation have filed a 'B' report dated 21.07.2023, before the concerned NC:
2024:KHC:40989 Court.
Therefore, the petitions in the form that are pending, are rendered infructuous.
2. In the light of the aforesaid submission, the petitions are disposed as having become infructuous.
I.A.No.1/2022 in both petitions stand disposed, as a consequence.

Sd/-
(M.NAGAPRASANNA) JUDGE NVJ CT:SS Naveen Kumar vs State Of Karnataka on 30 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100048874/
